releaseNotes:
## Weekly print
- Weekly overview now prints on a single A4 landscape page at 100% scale
- Notes, Meals, and Allergies stay on the sheet (empty cells still appear)
- Conference row prints only when there is a meeting that week
- Occupied-only room visibility is unchanged; print height comes from the rooms that actually print
- Family cells show the names assigned to that room, not the whole party
- Meeting cells no longer show “All day”
